content.title: American Idol 2026: Judges, Host, How to Audition, Premiere Date, Twist, Voting
content.text: Key PointsAmerican Idol returns for Season 9 on ABC, premiering January 26, 2026.Carrie Underwood joins as a judge alongside Lionel Richie and Luke Bryan.2025 winner Jamal Roberts made history as the second Black man to win Idol.American Idol will officially be back for a ninth season on ABC, the network announced. It will mark the 24th year overall for the competition series. “I think we just have to keep evolving, keep pushing, keep leveling up every year,” showrunner Megan Michaels Wolflick told Parade. “We already have thousands of submissions for next season, and they’re really good people. So I feel like the quality is only getting better.”Read More American Idol confirmed the big reveal on Instagram. “Dim the lights… here we go,” read the official caption. “#AmericanIdol is coming back for another season! 🎶.” Here’s what we know so far about American Idol 2026. 🎬 SIGN UP for Parade’s Daily newsletter to get the latest pop culture news & celebrity interviews delivered right to your inbox 🎬 What is the release date for American Idol 2026? American Idol will premiere early this year with the new season starting on Jan. 26, meaning it’s moving to Monday nights. What are the new twists for American Idol 2026? First, Idol’s iconic Hollywood Week round will move to Nashville when Hollywood Week: Music City Takeover will feature one round only as the hopefuls from all musical genres take the stage for a make-or-break performance, facing the biggest Hollywood Week cut in Idol’ history. Second, Executive Producer Megan Michaels Wolflick told Deadline that she is adding social media voting. “We have to meet the audience where they are,” she said. “Back in 2002 when the show began, texting was the new hot thing. We also have to meet the technology where it is, as well. We want to make it as easy as possible for people to vote for their favorites, weigh in from their couch with their second screen, in real time… If we can get Gen Alpha and Gen Z to weigh in a little bit more in the easiest way possible, that’s very exciting. It could tip the scale. Trends are always different.” And finally, there is the addition of the brand-new ‘Ohana Round. Filmed at Aulani, A Disney Resort & Spa in Ko Olina, the three-episode arc follows the iconic Hollywood Week, with the brand-new ’Ohana Round featured as one of those episodes, offering hopefuls a distinct moment in the competition. Designed as the ultimate focus group, the ’Ohana Round blends peer respect, emotional support and professional insight before the competition moves on to America’s Vote. Who are the American Idol judges in 2026? Lionel Richie Lionel RichieDisney/Scott Kirkland Luke Bryan Luke BryanDisney/Scott Kirkland Carrie Underwood Carrie UnderwoodDisney/Christopher Willard “This show is always about the finalists first and foremost,” Wolflick said of last season’s new judge. “Our three panelists are there to guide them along, and I think they did an exceptional job of doing that and making it all about positivity and uplifting. So I think Carrie crushed. Honestly, she really came into her own and carved out her own role. That was my hope for her. She wasn’t coming in as a copy and paste of anyone else. She was carving out Carrie Underwood, the American Idol judge.” Related: Carrie Underwood Fans Celebrate 20th Anniversary of Major Milestone for ‘the Song That Started It All’ Who is the host of American Idol? Ryan Seacrest Ryan SeacrestDisney/Scott Kirkland American Idol wouldn’t be American Idol without Ryan Seacrest as host. He’s the only original cast member remaining. Auditions are already underway. Sign up for a live virtual audition with one of the producers at americanidol.com/auditions. Who won American Idol 2025? R&B/soul singer Jamal Roberts walked away as the winner of American Idol 2025 and he made history in so doing, becoming only the second Black man to win the title in the singing competition’s history. “I felt Luke and Lionel pulling for me. I felt it,” Roberts said. “So, that’s why I stayed focused and I just continued the journey.” Related: American Idol Winner Jamal Roberts Reacts to Making History (Exclusive) When did American Idol begin? The reality singing competition premiered in 2002 on FOX with judges Simon Cowell, Paula Abdul and Randy Jackson. In 2016, after several seasons of declining ratings and several changes of judges, FOX canceled the series. Then, on March 11, 2018, a revival of the series began airing on ABC. How to vote on American Idol Fans of American Idol who are at least 13 and reside in the U.S., Puerto Rico or the Virgin Islands, can vote online at AmericanIdol.com/vote, in the American Idol app, or via text during the live shows. How to watch American Idol Tune into the competition on ABC, or stream on ABC.com or the ABC app after signing in with your TV service provider. How to stream American Idol American Idol can be streamed live with an on-demand ABC subscription or watch it the next day on Hulu. Related: How Much Do ‘American Idol’ Contestants Get Paid? Is American Idol on Netflix? Unfortunately not. But it is on Hulu! What time is American Idol on? American Idol airs on Sunday nights at 8 p.m. ET/PT. Season 8 also aired on Monday nights at 8 p.m. ET/PT. What channel is American Idol on? American Idol has aired on ABC since March 2018. The series originally aired on FOX from 2002-2016. If you miss the original airing, check it out on Hulu the next day.
